name: Corroding A.C.I.D.
text: Weapon damage against this unit is doubled. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected. Weapon damage against this unit is doubled. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected. Corroding A.C.I.D. can be inflicted on units through specific weapons, such as the A.C.I.D. Projector. It can also be present in the environment, on missions located in the Detritus Disposal island. Corroding A.C.I.D. will also disable Armor until the unit Repairs. A.C.I.D. applies to self-damage from weapons like Unstable Cannon, and doubles the increased damage taken resulting from a Booste

name: Smoke Tile
text: Most units cannot attack in Smoke. Units in Smoke cannot attack or repair. A Sand Tile that is hit by weapon damage will turn into a Smoke Tile. Some weapons and enemy attacks are capable of creating their own Smoke Tiles as well. Units under Smoke will be denoted with the Smoke status, and will clear if the unit moves out of Smoke. If a unit is on Fire when it moves into a Smoke Tile, the fire will be put out. On the other hand, if a Smoke Tile is hit by an attack that does fire damage, the Smoke will be replaced by a Fire Tile.
